name: hoc-test-execution
description: Run a project's test cases and drive them to green without weakening them — no test skipped, deleted or loosened to make the suite pass. Use this skill whenever tests are run, whenever a test still fails after an implementation was believed finished, and before claiming an implementation is complete. Writing new tests belongs to the project's test-writing convention; reusing a recorded pass over unchanged inputs, to the test-cache convention.
